control_group_definition.important_clarification: CONTROL in this experiment means NON-PEARL PATHOGENIC variants, NOT benign variants
control_group_definition.rationale: Experiment tests: Do pearls (VEP-blind pathogenic) show stronger CAGE disruption than non-pearls (VEP-detected pathogenic)?
control_group_definition.hypothesis: Pearls have regulatory mechanism (promoter/enhancer) → strong CAGE change. Non-pearls have coding mechanism (missense/frameshift) → weak CAGE change.
control_group_definition.evidence: All 19 controls are Pathogenic/Likely pathogenic in ClinVar (verified)

layer_5_statistics.position_in_distribution: Below mean (weaker disruption than average control)
layer_5_statistics.explanation: VCV000015545 correctly included in controls group (non-pearl pathogenic). CAGE disruption (-0.92%) weaker than group mean (-3.24%), consistent with coding mechanism (minimal transcriptional effect).

red_flags_detected.description: Control variant VCV000015545 is Pathogenic in ClinVar, not Benign
red_flags_detected.explanation: This is NOT a data error. The experiment compares pearls (VEP-blind pathogenic) vs controls (VEP-detected pathogenic), not pathogenic vs benign. All 19 controls are Pathogenic/Likely pathogenic by design. Hypothesis: regulatory-pathogenic variants show stronger CAGE disruption than coding-pathogenic variants.

conclusion: VCV000015545 passes full forensic check. Variant is real Pathogenic missense mutation (A141V), correctly identified as NON-PEARL by ARCHCODE (VEP detects it, score 0.885), correctly included in AlphaGenome controls group with valid CAGE output (-0.92% minimal disruption), and correctly included in controls statistics. CAGE near-zero change is biologically plausible (coding mechanism → protein disruption, not transcriptional disruption). No evidence of data fabrication.
